title: PIT index-reconstitution forced-flow drift (membership-reconstitution space)

outcome_blind_attestation.note: Proposal declares mechanisms, fields, clocks and falsification rules only. No scored-window returns, PF, Sharpe or ranking was computed anywhere in this sprint lane.

lens: Data/PIT: the edge is only measurable with effective-dated index membership (no current-membership backfill), PIT announcement/effective timestamps, and delisting-retained history. Naive backfilled membership data cannot even express the mechanism.

1_economic_mechanism_and_counterparty.mechanism: When a major cap-weighted benchmark announces an addition or deletion with a future effective date, funds that track the benchmark MUST trade the change at/near the effective close to avoid tracking error. This demand is mandate-driven and price-inelastic, producing a measurable price-pressure episode around the effective date (demand curves slope down). Announcements are public and timestamped strictly before the effective date, so the forced-flow event is point-in-time predictable even though index membership itself is not backfillable.
1_economic_mechanism_and_counterparty.expected_counterparty: Index-tracking funds and benchmark-constrained active managers who must transact at the effective rebalance regardless of price. They persist structurally because their objective is tracking error minimisation against a benchmarked mandate, not expected profit; every year produces new adds/deletes and the passive complex keeps growing, so the counterparty does not disappear.
1_economic_mechanism_and_counterparty.why_the_edge_persists: The other side of the trade cannot refuse to trade and cannot time-trade (mandate forbids it); arbitrage capital that pre-trades the announcement (recon front-running) competes the effect down but does not eliminate the forced flow itself. Residual drift should concentrate where tracked AUM per forced dollar traded is largest.

2_pit_fields_and_source_authority.source_authority_policy: Per research/assets/stocks/provider.py: every adapter defaults to NO_ENTITLEMENT_FAIL_CLOSED; authority requires a verified EntitlementRecord covering REQUIRED_LICENSE_SCOPE = (PIT_SECURITY_MASTER, DELISTINGS, CORPORATE_ACTIONS, HISTORY_WITH_ADJUSTMENTS) on an authority-capable source class. Free-convenience data is DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY and can never satisfy authority, including for announcement timestamps.
2_pit_fields_and_source_authority.data_readiness: Implementable against the synthetic-fixture factory NOW (membership rows, announcement events, synthetic bars). Real-data readiness BLOCKED pending owner-authorized entitlement (NO_ENTITLEMENT_FAIL_CLOSED).

3_universe_neutralization_benchmark.universe: US-listed common stocks (ETFs excluded from the signal book; ETFs may serve only as benchmark instruments). Eligibility via rebalance snapshots: history and median-dollar-volume rule with ACCEPTED and REJECTED rows both retained with reasons; >= 30 eligible liquid names per decision (S0 floor). Delisted members retained through their final valid event (evaluate_delisting_retention).
3_universe_neutralization_benchmark.neutralization: Sector-neutral dollar-neutral book: long announced additions, short announced deletions, matched within PIT sector buckets (sector as-of formation date); sector-level dollar neutrality enforced and zero net dollar exposure overall. No symbol above the Stage-A concentration cap.
3_universe_neutralization_benchmark.benchmark: Flat (absolute) plus SPY total return, evaluated inside a declared sector-neutral, dollar-neutral context (no index beta claim is made; the benchmark pair is the PLAN-mandated minimum set).

4_formation_holding_execution_clocks.decision_rule: Event-driven per announcement. A decision may use an announcement only at the first regular-session close strictly after the announcement's ts_ingest (PIT discipline; a signal may execute only on a LATER observable event -- one-event entry delay, per A5 execution helpers).
4_formation_holding_execution_clocks.formation: At the close S0 of the first regular session with start > announce_ts_ingest (next-close formation).
4_formation_holding_execution_clocks.entry: Next regular-session close after formation (declared close-event fill; no fill on halt / closed session / missing quote).
4_formation_holding_execution_clocks.holding: From entry close through the regular-session close 20 sessions after the membership change's effective date (fixed ex ante constant, not tuned; documented pressure windows in the literature are of this order).
4_formation_holding_execution_clocks.execution_events: Declared session-close events (calendar session_bounds; early closes honoured). VWAP-style intraday execution over the entry/exit session is expressible via loader intraday bars and becomes the fill path if/when the intraday entitlement and the >= 3y intraday floor are satisfied.
4_formation_holding_execution_clocks.overlap_policy: Overlapping event books aggregate; per-name weight caps; no re-entry into the same (security_id, announcement) pair.

5_turnover_and_capacity.expected_turnover_order_of_magnitude: Each announcement generates one round trip per name with ~25-session holding => each name turns ~8-10x per year while held. Aggregated at book level: major-index maintenance typically yields order 10-40 announced changes/year plus a large annual reconstitution event; effective book turnover order 4-10x/year of average one-side notional.
5_turnover_and_capacity.capacity_reasoning: Capacity is bounded by (a) square-root impact with a hard order-size cap at a declared fraction of ADV (orders above the cap DO NOT fill) and (b) event concentration: a single annual reconstitution must execute through closing-auction liquidity, so per-name order size must stay a small fraction of that name's effective-date volume. Order-of-magnitude capacity: tens of millions to low hundreds of millions USD strategy AUM; deletions (often deteriorating names with wide spreads) bind first.
5_turnover_and_capacity.cost_feasibility_gate: Schedule-only turnover and cost feasibility must be demonstrated (PLAN §10) before scoring; family dies if edge does not survive commission x1.5, spread x1.5 and impact at declared ADV participation caps.

anchor.definition: Long announced additions / short announced deletions of the primary benchmark; sector-neutral dollar-neutral; formation next-close after announcement ingest; entry next close; exit effective+20 sessions; borrow-gated shorts.

neighbour.justification: Same forced-flow mechanism, different identification: rule-based (non-discretionary) reconstitution of a threshold-split benchmark family (Russell-style float-cap assignment boundary). Names are added/deleted purely by rule, isolating forced benchmark flow from committee discretion; regression-discontinuity evidence attributes price effects around this recon to inclusion itself (Chang, Hong & Liskovich 2015, JFE). If the mechanism is real, the neighbour must support the anchor.
neighbour.definition: Same clocks, neutralization and gates as the anchor, applied to the rule-based recon event set of the threshold-split benchmark complex.

negative_control.justification: Severs the causal link (forced inelastic flow) while keeping the observable, clock and neutralization identical: apply the identical formation/holding/execution schedule to membership changes of a matched index in the same vendor family that has economically negligible tracking assets (no investable tracking products, near-zero benchmarked AUM).
negative_control.expected_if_mechanism_real: The control arm's after-cost edge must be destroyed (indistinguishable from zero after costs). If the control shows materially the same drift as the anchor, the anchor's edge is a characteristic confound (e.g. adds are high-momentum small caps that drift anyway) and the family is FALSIFIED.

7_corporate_action_earnings_borrow_divid.corporate_actions: Splits and cash dividends applied exactly once at ex/effective timestamps (A4 engine); declared RAW fill path vs TOTAL_RETURN research path with reconciliation; delisted names retained through final valid event, and a deletion position exited at its delisting event rather than silently dropped.
7_corporate_action_earnings_borrow_divid.earnings: Earnings events inside the holding window are NOT signals; positions are held through them. PIT earnings timestamps classified BTO/AMC with fail-closed UNKNOWN (A4) used only for audit/attribution, never for re-entry or lookahead.
7_corporate_action_earnings_borrow_divid.borrow: Every short requires locate plus a PIT borrow rate (A5); unavailable borrow => the short is REJECTED (never filled for free), recorded as a REJECTED row with reason, book re-normalizes; coverage ratio reported per event. Deletions frequently have deteriorating borrow -- the family accepts reduced short coverage.
7_corporate_action_earnings_borrow_divid.dividends: Cash dividend receipt on longs and short dividend liability on shorts per the A5 accounting identity; special dividends passed through and reconciled.

8_falsification_and_external_validity.falsification_rule: Family dies if ANY of: (a) negative control arm retains materially the anchor's after-cost edge (confound, not forced flow); (b) neighbour contradicts the anchor; (c) edge vanishes under one-event entry delay, x1.5 costs, impact at declared ADV caps, or borrow x2/unavailable stress; (d) the edge exists only when computed with backfilled current membership rather than members_as_of effective rows (data artifact); (e) any Stage-A gate fails (PLAN §13).
8_falsification_and_external_validity.external_validity_caveats: Documented regime dependence: inclusion effects have decayed as the passive complex grew and reconstitution trading became industrialised (anticipation documented already in the 1990s); announcement-to-effective windows changed historically by era, so window constants must be declared per announcement-era from PIT records, never assumed uniform; results must be reported by sub-period and by flow intensity (tracked AUM) buckets. Russell-style neighbour identification depends on band/rank assignment rules that themselves changed over time -- each era needs its own PIT rule record.

ineligibility_attestation.not_an_indicator_grid: No lookback/threshold grid: one announcement event type, one declared window constant set, one neutralization; nothing is tuned to outcomes.

not_a_crypto_family_rescue.vs_M01_aggressor_flow_absorption: Different observable (PIT effective-dated membership + scheduled announcements vs order-book aggressor imbalance), different counterparty (mandate-forced index funds vs momentum aggressors), different clock (multi-week announcement->effective schedule vs intraday absorption), different causal control (no-tracking-AUM index vs crypto control).
not_a_crypto_family_rescue.vs_funding_carry: No funding-rate observable or carry term anywhere.
not_a_crypto_family_rescue.vs_weekly_reversal: Event-driven low-frequency book around scheduled reconstitutions, not a periodic reversal clock.
